name: minecraft-discord-bot
description: A feature-rich and highly customizable Discord bot that provides information about your Minecraft server.

scripts.setup: cp docker-compose.example.yml docker-compose.yml && echo '已創建 docker-compose.yml，請編輯裡面的環境變數'
scripts.docker:deploy: docker buildx inspect multiarch >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker buildx create --name multiarch --driver docker-container --bootstrap && docker buildx build --builder multiarch --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t crazycat836/minecraftrobot:latest -t crazycat836/minecraftrobot:$npm_package_version --push .

author: crazycat836
